name: Fuyu to Iu Na no Bistro
original_name: 冬という名のビストロ
source:
This cafe's name is "Bistrot hiver". Hiver means winter in French. Main character finds this place on a winter day, and his body and mind soften with its warmth. He becomes a regular her and starts to treat this place as second home.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-december-2006-kimi-no-koe.html]vndbreview[/url]]
